==Notes==
*When used with [[Contagion]] and [[Dark Aura]], Dark Aura's damage will be triggered twice.
*Can be followed with [[Unholy Feast]] to quickly recover the lost health and for additional [[AoE]] damage.
*Consider bringing [[Plague Touch]] or [[Plague Sending]] to transfer the bleeding.
*This skill is commonly used by [[Saccer]]s to force-trigger [[Death Nova]].
*The AI will only use this skill if at least two foes are within range.
